top_signals.title: Rubio Warns Ukraine Stalemate Could Turn Into Wider Conflict
top_signals.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio warned that Russia's war against Ukraine is at a stalemate but could escalate into a broader regional conflict if the deadlock pushes either side toward increasingly dangerous actions. Speaking in Lisbon on the final stop of a three-country swing through NATO allies Iceland, Greece, and Portugal, Rubio said Washington believes the war ultimately requires a negotiated settlement and remains ready to facilitate diplomacy. top_signals.title: NYC Mayor Mamdani Says ICE 'Makes Us Less Safe'
top_signals.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani repeats his call for the abolishment of the Immigration and Customs Enforcement enforcement agency after an officer shot and wounded a man in front of a child on Thursday in the Bronx. Mamdani says ICE makes the city "less safe." ICE says the shooting happened as part of a targeted operation. The child was unharmed, the victim is in stable condition at a local hosptial. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Venture Global Loses LNG Arbitration to Portugal's Galp
top_signals.summary: A court has ruled that Venture Global breached its contract with Portugal’s Galp in the second unfavorable ruling for the U.S. LNG major. Galp was one of half a dozen energy companies that sued Venture Global for violating its long-term supply contracts for liquefied gas in order to make a fatter profit on the spot market. BP scored the other win against the U.S. company, while Shell and Spain’s Repsol lost their disputes with Venture Global. Italy’s Edison agreed to a settlement with Venture Global.
